title: Step 1: Remember Things
story: A key-value store is the heart of caches and databases. You will build a tiny one, step by step.
goal: Write class KV with set(key, value) and get(key, default=None).
hints: Keep a dict inside the object, created in __init__.
get can use dict.get with the default.
socratic: What should this new piece take in, and give back?
Which earlier piece can you reuse?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: how does this checkpoint build on the last one?
